meta.name: AISEE Webapp 5.5 Growth Overview
meta.description: Current Webapp UI Kit baseline extracted from the 5.5 Growth Overview reference.

color.palette_type: neutral with lime and soft green accents

primary.role: analysis progress, credit progress and high-emphasis system feedback

secondary.role: Growth banner and supporting score-growth surfaces

accent.role: AI suggestion actions and positive lift indicators

neutral.usage: White cards on a light gray page with dark text and cool gray metadata

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light with restrained tinted areas for workflow emphasis

typography.font_style_notes: Karla only across the dApp, including data and navigation

spacing.section_rhythm: 12px card gaps, 24px major regions and 32px main padding

layout.grid_system: fixed header and sidebar with fluid main dashboard grid
layout.columns: 4 KPI columns followed by asymmetric two-column content
layout.alignment_tendency: left aligned, strong shared edges and consistent card baselines

shape.border_usage: 1px low-contrast borders on cards and controls, stronger only for interaction

elevation.depth_cues: surface tint and borders before shadow

iconography.style: rounded outline with select filled status marks
iconography.preferred_set: AISEE internal icon library with Lucide-compatible fallback

motion.entrance_pattern: short opacity and translate transitions for overlays only

components.button_style: 36-44px controls, 8-10px radius, black or green action fills
components.input_style: 36px white input with subtle border and module-color interaction ring
components.card_style: white 12-16px radius cards with 1px subtle border and almost no shadow
components.navigation_pattern: 70px brand header plus 224px grouped project sidebar
components.modal_style: white 16px radius layer with restrained shadow and 24px internal padding
components.list_style: stacked 72-96px task rows with status pills and right-aligned actions
components.component_notes: Overview, Growth, Engage and Post live in one project sidebar; 5.5 removes the old top module toggle from the primary shell

visual_language.complexity: moderate information density with simple surfaces
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: sidebar and banner establish context; white content cards carry detail
visual_language.focal_strategy: pale green workflow banner then KPI strip then growth tasks
visual_language.contrast_level: medium-high for text, low for container boundaries

composition.hierarchy_method: group labels, card scale, numeric emphasis and restrained tint
composition.flow_direction: top to bottom, left score evidence to right action plan
composition.grouping_strategy: nested cards and sidebar section labels
composition.negative_space_role: separates workflow phases and prevents dense data from feeling heavy

imagery.illustration_style: small functional line illustrations in tinted square containers
imagery.graphic_elements: progress lines, pills, stars and simple charts
imagery.image_shape: rounded square icon containers and circular project marks

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: 5 percent dark fill or slightly stronger border
interaction_feel.loading_style: stable skeleton cards and progress indicators

overview.fallback_strategy: static CSS with no movement under prefers-reduced-motion

visual_effects.composite_notes: The reference relies on typography, grouping and low-contrast surfaces rather than special visual effects.
